title: Puharich's lecture admitting work for the CIA

tellings.quote: I worked for this part of the CIA. My boss was the guy who was directly involved with all the hypnosis mind manipulation stuff.

plain: Around 1995, at conferences on psychic phenomena, a scientist named Andrija Puharich gave a lecture saying he had worked for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, and that his boss was directly involved in its hypnosis and mind manipulation work. An unnamed researcher retells this to Michels, quoting Puharich as saying, "I worked for this part of the CIA." If true, it would tie Puharich's later claims of contact with an alien council to US intelligence.
